The '''Galactic Alliance Finance Council''' was a subdivision of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] in operation as of [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. At this time, [[Pefederan Lloyn]], who owned corporate properties on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], served as the chairbeing of the Council.
